main_text.head: AD CANDIDVM LECTOREM.
main_text.p: QVæ cernis, tenui Musæ congesta libello Scripta, tibi Marci, Lector amice dicant.
Nil veritæ fructus studiÿ submittere primos Censura vulgi, judicioq; gravi.
Nec tamen ignaræ, qp nō sint æque habitura Laudem, ut compta nimis, tersaq; scripta bene.
Sed candore magis nixæ, atq; favore bonorū, Quam propriis ausis, ingenioq; suo.
Præsidio idcirco hoc tutæ, te Momeproterve Nil curant, risus nil metuunt q; tuos
Quod si forte leves vocitas hac nomine iniquo
Nugas, nec quicquā laudis habere putas:
Despicis eximium Marci si mente laborem, Ad logices fructus qui tibi pandit iter:

page.notes: Woodcut headline ornament and small ornament below the heading are decorative, not transcribed. The line "Nil curant, risus nil metuunt q; tuos" and the line "Quod si forte leves vocitas hac nomine iniquo" are copied as printed; the words "Momeproterve" and "vocitas" are run together or irregular in print and are left as printed. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout. The verse is set as stanza-like lines; the printed initial Q is joined to the first word. Several lines contain irregular spacing and possible ligatures; the reading of "scripta" and "tersaq;" is slightly uncertain. Possible printing errors left unchanged.
